ImageDescription.value: Trubarjeva street is one of the many streets in Ljubljana which are temporary under reconstruction. On one side of the street the work is still in progress (digging, driving vans, lorries, workers talking) while one part of the street near Prešern’s square the works are finished. The recording was done by walking from one part of the street to the other. Various sounds can be heard (walking, digging, talking, driving, …). The soundscape was recorded on 18th July 2019 At 9.15AM.
